blockingActions.action: Candidate publication bridge uses absolute configured interpreter and -I; 52 installed-wheel synthetic client/scope/account/Kinoko regressions PASS. Main baseline source discovery is historical. Compute/Annual/merged-read-worker and full running-writer installed-runtime coverage remain unmigrated or unaccepted.
Inventory actual running writers and stop legacy writers before controlled canonical adoption; source review cannot prove active coverage.
Run isolated integrated cross-writer failure/restore checks including daily archives, SQL lifecycle receipts and immutable history; record RPO/RTO.
Keep legacy C/H projections explicitly non-snapshot-isolated; canonical immutable lease readers are required for coherent multi-file reads.

legacyReaderConstraint: Legacy direct C/H projections are installed one file at a time before committed pointer switch and can expose mixed generations to readers lacking a shared lease. Only canonical immutable readers under Source SH have snapshot consistency. Activation requires consumer inventory/migration or exclusion from concurrent writes; never advertise legacy path snapshot isolation.
